scope: Every assignment/incdec selector, indexed or indirect target in the three binder source files. Local-variable reassignment is excluded. Helper-induced mutations require auditing the separately inventoried callees.
limitations: Overlay families are design proposals, not generated runtime layout. Non-AST targets are retained for audit rather than discarded. Calls such as GetLocals/GetMembers/GetExports can allocate/mutate through their source helpers and are not disguised as direct assignments.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: GetSymbolTable
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: Lazily writes an allocated-empty table through *data when nil; pointer arguments can name SourceFile.GlobalExports as well as symbol/node tables.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: SetBindDiagnostics
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: Replaces SourceFile.bindDiagnostics with the appended diagnostic slice supplied by the binder.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: BindOnce
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: Consumes sync.Once even on panic; writes isBound only after the initializer returns successfully.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: GetNodeId
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: May increment process-global nextNodeId and CAS Node.id; binder-derived symbol names embed this identity.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: GetSymbolId
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: May increment process-global nextSymbolId and CAS Symbol.id; private-identifier symbol names embed this identity.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: NewFlowSwitchClauseData
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: Allocates an AST node and initializes SwitchStatement, ClauseStart and ClauseEnd; source clause indices narrow to int32.

reviewed_helper_mutations.name: NewFlowReduceLabelData
reviewed_helper_mutations.effect: Allocates an AST node and initializes Target and Antecedents; retains their graph identities through flow ownership.

identity_derived_name_sites.observation_requirement: Represent the referenced node identity separately from the literal internal-name prefix/module-name/pattern suffix; comparing raw process-global numeric text is not allocation-independent.
Represent the containing class symbol identity and description separately; preserve ordinary raw symbol names exactly.
